organization.name: Invoice Ninja LLC
organization.notes: Founder-run company launched March 2014; official current story explicitly calls business 100% self-funded. No outside equity investors identified or implied.

pricingTiers.name: Self-hosted
pricingTiers.notes: Self-hosted software free under ELv2, not OSI OSS. Optional annual white-label licensing and external services separate.

pricingTiers.name: Ninja Pro
pricingTiers.notes: Explicitly Most popular; $14/month or $140 annually per FAQ. Cloud plan, not a self-host fee.

pricingTiers.name: Premium Business
pricingTiers.notes: Custom package advertised from $280/year; final scope and price require contact. Minimum published annual amount only.

pricingTiers.name: Enterprise
pricingTiers.notes: Starting $18/month for 1–2 users; annual total $180 derived from $36 annual savings versus 12 monthly payments. Scales to $300/month for 51–100 users.

moats.claim: Invoice/payment automation, client portals and established integrations can create workflow switching costs for invoice-heavy businesses.

productReasons.claim: Recurring invoices, auto-billing, deposits and partial payments support flexible client billing.
Project timers and Kanban boards convert billable work into invoicing records.
Client portals consolidate invoices, payments and document exchange without separate customer record tools.

sponsorship.notes: No separate corporate financial/in-kind sponsor identified in reviewed official project and business pages. Verified commercial steward included as business fallback; customers, partners and investors are not classified as sponsors.

requirements.notes: bcmath, ctype, imagick, soap, gd, mbstring, openssl, tokenizer, xml, curl, zip, gmp, iconv, mysqli, intl; FPM with nginx.
Runs schedule:run every minute for scheduled workflows.
Sync queue alternative exists; shared hosting can use periodic queue:work cron. Redis is not required by this default.

requirements.condition: When sending email: SMTP or documented API mail provider

requirements.component: Postmark, Mailgun, Brevo or Amazon SES

requirements.notes: External accounts/API credentials may incur provider fees; one provider sufficient.

resources.os: Linux; Ubuntu 20.04+/CentOS 8+ listed on getting-started page
resources.notes: Only explicit documented hardware figures included; null means no minimum verified in reviewed installation source.

selfHosting.notes: v5 manual PHP stack; current detailed installation guide requires PHP 8.2, while general getting-started page says 8.1+. Prefer detailed guide. Hardware figures from first-party getting-started page. Native clients still connect to server API; they do not replace backend.

options.name: Softaculous one-click
options.notes: Official documentation directly offers Softaculous one-click installation on supported hosting panels.

options.name: Cloudron marketplace
options.notes: Official documentation directly links Cloudron marketplace installation; Cloudron server required.

oneClickInstall.notes: Verified options listed; manual multi-step installation and Docker Compose alone are not treated as one-click.
